depth.description: Stockfish search depth per move (default 14, clamped 1-30). Depth 14 completes full games in 4-7s, well under client timeouts.
depth.title: Depth

detail.description: Analysis detail level: 'standard' (fast batch), 'coach' (turning points & story), 'forensic' (deep verification).
detail.title: Detail

max_critical_moments.description: Maximum number of critical moments to extract (clamped between 1 and 7, default 6).
max_critical_moments.title: Max Critical Moments

perspective.description: Player perspective for coaching analysis ('white' or 'black').
perspective.title: Perspective

pgn.description: PGN string, annotated game text, or SAN move list to analyze.
pgn.title: Pgn

strict.description: When True, reject non-canonical SAN syntax or move numbers.
strict.title: Strict

compare_moves.description: Optional list of up to 8 alternative legal candidate moves FOR THE SAME PLAYER whose turn it is in the position (e.g. ['Nf3', 'd4']). Must be legal moves for the current player to move, NOT opponent replies.
compare_moves.title: Compare Moves

detail.description: Detail level: 'standard' for fast grade/loss, 'coach' for tactical snapshots and reply, 'forensic' for candidate comparison and verification.
detail.title: Detail

fen.description: FEN string representing the chess position before the move.
fen.title: Fen

move.description: The move played by the side to move (in SAN or UCI notation, e.g. 'e4', 'Nf3', 'O-O', 'e2e4').
